# The programme, for a reviewer

A generated front door. Every figure below is derived from the repository's own metadata;
none is transcribed. Where coverage is partial, this page says so rather than rounding up.

## The object

The figure-eight knot complement **m004** -- the unique arithmetic knot complement, trace
field `Q(sqrt-3)`. The programme asks what such an object forces, and reports that it forces
**form** while refusing **values**. Most results are therefore negatives, and that is the
result, not the debt.

**PROVED — `B8088`** (549 words, 0 locks)  
THE Z/5 MENU IS HOMOGENEOUS, BUT ARITHMETICALLY: ONE W x GALOIS ORBIT PER ROW, WHILE W ALONE GIVES 25 ORBITS AND SPLITS 8 OF THE 9 ROWS. Tests the owner's claim, attributed to B8086, that the menu is 'exactly one W x Galois orbit per row -- perfectly homogeneous'. B8086 did NOT establish this: it verified the nine rows, their counts and that every row has rank 6, but never computed orbits, and 'one orbit per row' is strictly stronger than 'one centraliser type per row' since a row is a FIBRE of the type map and a fibre may be a union of orbits of the same type. THE CLAIM HOLDS: nine rows, nine W x Galois orbits, one-to-one, sizes matching B8086's banked counts exactly [4320,4320,2160,1728,1440,864,540,144,108]; argued rather than eyeballed, since each row is a UNION of orbits (type constant on orbits, controlled) and a partition into 9 parts refined by a partition into 9 parts is the same partition. THE SHARPENING: under W ALONE there are 25 orbits and eight of nine rows split -- only A3 (2160) is already a single W-orbit; D5's 108 is 4 x 27, A4's 1728 is 4 x 432, A5's 144 is 2 x 72, and so on. The Galois action (Z/5)* fixes each vanishing set POINTWISE (scaling a pairing by a unit cannot change whether it is zero) so it can only fuse WITHIN a row, and it does, collapsing 25 to 9. CONSEQUENCE, and it is the load-bearing one: a single orbit forces a UNIQUE invariant measure while a union of k orbits admits a (k-1)-parameter family, so the 'only object-consistent measure is uniform' step is forced by W x GALOIS-invariance and NOT by W-invariance -- the measure argument needs the ARITHMETIC symmetry as a stated hypothesis. Also explains a number: the external proposal's 108 = 27x4, offered as an observation, is literally four Galois-conjugate W-orbits of size 27. SCOPE: the W-action on the 5-torsion of the E6 torus; nothing about the manifold, and nothing about whether the Z/5 menu is this object's -- B8086 showed it is NOT (H_1 = Z, torsion-free). Gate 5 untouched.

**NEGATIVE — `B8086`** (510 words, 0 locks)  
THE Z/5 WILSON-LINE MENU CANNOT REACH THE SM: EVERY ROW HAS RANK 6, AND B955 IS RE-DERIVED BY A SECOND, UNRELATED ROUTE. An outside proposal (relayed by the owner) argued the VEV-direction gap closes via a finite Z/5 Wilson-line menu over E6: generic collapse giving the left-right group at 27.6%, exceptional collapse giving so(10)+u(1) at 0.7% with 108 = 27x4 directions, each two priced VEVs from the SM, compressing the gap to one binary bit. Recomputed from the E6 Cartan matrix over all 5^6-1 = 15624 non-identity 5-torsion elements. MOSTLY RIGHT: the union of all rows regenerates e6 (72/72 roots), the intersection is the Cartan alone u(1)^6 (0 common roots), and the rarest row IS so(10)+u(1) = D5+u(1) at 108 = 0.69%, a unique minimum, with 108 = 27x4. WRONG ON THE MODE: two rows tie at 4320 (27.65%) -- A1+A1+A2+u(1)^2 (left-right) AND A1+A3+u(1)^2 -- so 'the most probable row is the left-right group' is false and GENERIC COLLAPSE DOES NOT SELECT AT ALL; this sharpens their preferred half, since only the extremal rule returns a unique row. AND THE MECHANISM IS DEAD TWICE OVER: (1) the menu is not this object's -- the paper computes H_1(M_m) = Z + (Z/m)^2, so the golden member m=1 has H_1 = Z, TORSION-FREE, with no Z/5 at all; that menu belongs to m=5, a different manifold; (2) even granting it, EVERY one of the nine rows has RANK 6 while the SM has rank 4, and so(10)+u(1) is rank 6 too, so the exceptional collapse lands on another rank-6 row and still needs <1> and <nu^c> -- the very step the proposal set out to source. THE SECOND ROUTE IS THE POINT: this independently re-derives B955, which proved rank-preservation STRUCTURALLY from H_1 = Z being cyclic (cyclic image, one generator, centraliser contains a maximal torus, so rank is preserved NECESSARILY); here the same wall is reached by EXHAUSTIVE ENUMERATION with no shared step, so the wall is not an artefact of how B955 chose to argue. SCOPE: centralisers of 5-torsion torus elements of E6; nothing about the member, class, sisters or rows, and nothing about NON-abelian holonomy -- B955 closes the abelian instance of Route B, not Route B. Gate 5 untouched.

## How to falsify any of this

1. Every closure names an **escape hatch** -- the computation that would reopen it. Pick a
   door in `CLOSED_DOORS.md`, run its hatch; the door holds or it does not.
2. Every PROVED arc names its **test locks**. Run them.
3. The gates (`python3 scripts/gates/gates.py`) enforce the governance invariants, and each
   was verified by deliberate breakage -- a gate never observed to fail is not a gate.

You do not need to read the record to check the programme. That is the point of this page.
